title: The Number on the Bottom

slices.alt: Comic, part 1 of 12: Verdict Picks Toon: The Number on the Bottom Caption: December. June's favorite gadget comes out of the drawer. Grandma June: One quick charge, and my pocket stays toasty all walk.
Comic, part 2 of 12: Caption: July 30, 2026: the CPSC recalled about 1.5 million OCOOPA rechargeable hand warmers (recall 26-659).
Comic, part 3 of 12: Jo: Grandma, WAIT! Don't plug it in! (Sound: !!)
Comic, part 4 of 12: Caption: The CPSC counted 1,480 overheating reports, 15 fires, 350 burn injuries and one death.
Comic, part 5 of 12: Vera: Don't go by the brand. Flip it over. Vera: The model number is printed on the bottom.

Comic, part 6 of 12: Board, The recalled model numbers (CPSC, 2026): OCOOPA (26-659) UT3053 · UT3056; OCOOPA (26-659) H01 · H01(PD); OCOOPA (26-659) ZLS-118 · 118S · 118D; HotHands electric (27-011) H163650; Gobi Heat (27-009) UT3053 Sources: CPSC recalls 26-659 (July 30), 27-011 and 27-009 (Oct 1, 2026).

Comic, part 7 of 12: Grandma June: This isn't even that brand, dear. Jo: The number counts. UT3053 was recalled under two brands. Board, Same model number, two brands: UT3053 as OCOOPA recalled July 30; UT3053 as Gobi Heat recalled Oct 1 Source: CPSC recalls 26-659 and 27-009.
Comic, part 8 of 12: Grandma June: It's been in my coat pocket all week!
Comic, part 9 of 12: Board, If the number matches: Stop using it don't charge it; Claim the refund steps in the CPSC notice; Battery, not trash hazardous-waste drop-off
Comic, part 10 of 12: Jo: A few cold walks a season? Plain packs need no battery. Caption: Our guide: buy a rechargeable only if you use one most cold days, and its number is not on the list.
Comic, part 11 of 12: Vera: Whatever you buy: charge it while you're awake and nearby. Caption: Never overnight, never on a bed or under a pillow. Charge on a hard surface (CPSC battery advice).

Comic, part 12 of 12: Caption: Two minutes to read a number. Then the walk. Grandma June: Next time, I check the bottom first. Is yours on the list? The model numbers, the refund steps and the warmers we would buy instead are below.
